description: This file defines a JavaScript module for API client operations, providing functions to perform HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with automatic handling of authorization via AuthService and error handling for authentication failures.

methods.name: callApi(url, options = {})
methods.description: Performs an API call with specified URL and options, manages authorization headers, handles authentication errors by redirecting to login, and returns the JSON response.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified URL using callApi.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request with data payload to the specified URL using callApi.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with data payload to the specified URL using callApi.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the specified URL using callApi.
